content:
Following the announcement of visionOS 27 earlier today during the WWDC26 keynote, Apple has released the first developer beta of the system. Here are the details.

visionOS 27 beta 1 now available

Apple announced visionOS 27 today, alongside iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and visionOS 27.

visionOS 27 introduces the Siri AI app, Visual Intelligence features, and under-the-hood improvements for system and reliability.

As expected, Apple is now rolling out the first wave of developer betas for the systems announced during the WWDC26 keynote, including visionOS 27.

Apple hasn’t published the full release notes yet, but they’ll be available here.

If you want to enroll in the developer beta program for Apple Vision Pro, here’s what you’ve got to do:

  • Back up your Apple Vision Pro
  • Open the Settings app
  • Choose “General”
  • Choose “Software Update”
  • Select “Beta Updates”
  • Select “visionOS Developer Beta”

We are digging through the new visionOS 27 beta 1, and will report back with what we find that Apple might not have revealed during the keynote.

In the meantime, you can head over to our news hub for the full coverage of WWDC26.

Did you spot anything new in visionOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
